notes.title: Thanks for playing!
notes.content:
Thanks for playing our rough demo, we hope you enjoyed even if it was a little (a lot) rough.

We wanted to share the plans for the coming weeks as we ramp up towards release.

We have neglected the demo a little bit on purpose as we focus on the EA release coming towards the end of July. The demo might get an update, fixing the worst issues but don't expect anything before the actual EA release, on which there will also be a matching demo release.

Over the next coming weeks we will try and post some screenshots from the internal build and show some glimpses of what is coming.

- different basic towers (right now only D4 was special with a close ranged attack)
- shop with various upgrades and effects
- different enemy types with special abilities
- persistent meta progression
- more maps
- character selection
- mini-games
... and a working options menu :)

notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
- fixed issued with placing towers on corners
- fixed being able to build towers inside your home
- added highlights to buttons
- added exit/retry/main buttons to endscreen
- right click cancels building mode
- enabled timer and wave gui
- portal opens
- replaced main menu background
- nerfed D4 melee tower, more accurate attack and lower range
- enabled combat text
- added the real "start wave button"
- basic camera controls added

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
- enabled mana as resource
- mana drops from enemies, collect using mouse
- small fixes
- towers also cost mana
- enabled some missing sounds

notes.title: Demo Out Now
notes.content:
The demo is finally out, but late for the Next Fest launch.

Hey guys! This is our first game, and we are extremely excited to be a part of the Next Festival! Due to last minute changes and bug fixes, we are still working on the demo, so expect changes the upcoming days. We sincerely apologize!

Due to work hours the first huge batch of fixes will be available tomorrow evening (11th of June) no earlier than around 20 UTC.

Fixes include but are not limited to:
- Mana costs working correctly
- Store enabled, allowing for additions to each die type
- D8 and D10 correctly added
- D12 and D20 might appear (but otherwise wednesday)

We have a lot of small fixes and features that unfortunately didn't make but they are to be added in the coming days as mentioned.

Thanks for your patience.

Zenflux Games.
